name: Unholy Angel: Wedding Adventures
source:
Unholy Angel is a captivating visual novel that delves into the lives of Diana, a stunning young blonde, and her fiancé, Brian. Their journey begins as they plan to marry on the exotic paradise island of El-Paraiso. Little do they know, life has its own unexpected twists and turns in store for them.

As you progress through the game, you'll guide Diana and Brian through a series of challenging situations, testing their moral compass and loyalty. Your choices will shape their destinies.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/bunny_devil/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《邪恶天使》是一部引人入胜的视觉小说，深入探讨了迷人的年轻金发女郎戴安娜和她的未婚夫布莱恩的生活。他们的旅程开始于他们计划在异国天堂埃尔帕莱索岛结婚。他们殊不知，生活有意想不到的曲折等待着他们。

随着游戏的进展，你将引导戴安娜和布莱恩应对一系列具有挑战性的情况，测试他们的道德指南针和忠诚度。你的选择将决定他们的命运。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/bunny_devil/about]Patreon[/url]]
